svg.title: F-10 guide-word scenes
svg.desc: Guide-word scenes for F-10 Bound every command to a safety envelope and stop the vehicle independently. M02 Stops functioning: The monitor stops passing commands; the vehicle's own stop must take over (AOU-11) or it keeps going (H-07). M03 Unrequested function: An intervention without reason; hard braking for nothing (H-03). M04 Function stuck: A stale bounded command passed on; the vehicle does not slow (H-02). M05 Excessive function: Limits tighter than intended; unneeded hard braking as in M03 (H-03, rated as M03). M07 Functions early: An early intervention; as M03 (H-03, rated as M03). M09 Applies too short: The hold is released too early; the vehicle moves off (H-05). M12 Inverse function: The monitor commands acceleration where it should brake, or releases where it should hold (H-01). M13 Erratic or intermittent: Interventions come and go; each acts as M03 (H-03, rated as M03).
